summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A., submitting an amended and restated bylaws document (English translation). It does not relate to any special situation such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The submission is a routine corporate governance update and is not actionable as a special situation event.
